release: Name Resolution Render Accumulator & Wait Telemetry
name: Name Resolution Render Accumulator & Wait Telemetry
changes: Replaces the ineffective one-shot All Posts resolver render timer with a bounded soft-window accumulator that can combine sequential filename-resolution result batches before rebuilding the article DOM.

Automatic name-resolution rendering keeps the existing 1.4-second soft point but may wait up to 3.0 seconds for a second result batch; a second batch flushes immediately instead of extending the deadline.
Manual Resolve more names uses a three-batch target with a 4.2-second hard cap and still flushes immediately when the manual pass completes.
Adds name_resolution_render_wait telemetry and advances the passive browsing performance contract to schema 7 so production diagnostics can measure batching efficiency versus visible delay.
Preserves the accepted six-slot high-connection Video ceiling, five-request Image HTTP gate, provider allocation, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Discover, Smart Import, and Automation behavior.
regression_guards: Automatic resolver renders retain a 1.4-second soft point, never wait more than 3.0 seconds, and flush immediately when two result batches have accumulated.
Manual resolver renders target three batches, never wait more than 4.2 seconds, and the existing manual-finally flush remains intact.
Browsing telemetry schema is 7 and accepts name_resolution_render_wait while retaining name_resolution_batch and all schema-6 Image/Video telemetry.
High-connection Video concurrency remains six, Image HTTP admission remains five, 800/800/1000 browsing headers remain unchanged, and SABnzbd remains 5.1.2.
release_name: Name Resolution Render Accumulator & Wait Telemetry
